title: Scripture and Evangelism
definition: Scripture and evangelism belong together because the Gospel message is revealed in the Word and faith comes by hearing the word of Christ.
summary: Evangelism must proclaim the biblical Gospel of Jesus Christ.
christFocus: Christ is the message of evangelism, and Scripture bears witness to His death and resurrection for sinners.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Evangelism must be shaped by Scripture because Scripture defines the Gospel. It tells the truth about God, sin, judgment, Christ, repentance, faith, forgiveness, and eternal life.

Without Scripture, evangelism can become vague inspiration, moral improvement, or pressure to make a decision without understanding Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People need more than religious encouragement; they need the saving message God has revealed. Scripture and evangelism matters because faith comes through the word of Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Use Scripture when sharing the Gospel. Explain sin, grace, the cross, resurrection, repentance, and faith clearly. Trust God to use His Word.
